lalbagh_botanical_garden.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden & Glass House
lalbagh_botanical_garden.description: Renowned 240-acre botanical garden commissioned by Hyder Ali in 1760. Features the iconic London Crystal Palace-inspired Glass House, a 3,000-million-year-old rock, and over 1,800 exotic tropical plant species.
lalbagh_botanical_garden.best_time_to_visit: Early morning for fresh air or during the bi-annual Republic Day and Independence Day flower shows.

cubbon_park.name: Cubbon Park & Bamboo Groves
cubbon_park.description: Historical 300-acre green lung in the heart of Bengaluru established in 1870. Boasts majestic mahogany trees, lush bamboo groves, ornamental flowerbeds, and classical British-era neo-classical buildings.
cubbon_park.best_time_to_visit: 06:00 AM to 09:00 AM for morning walks, jogging, and serene bird-watching.

bangalore_palace.name: Bangalore Palace
bangalore_palace.description: Majestic 19th-century royal palace built by Chamaraja Wadiyar in Tudor Revival style, featuring fortified towers, battlements, elegant wood carvings, and renowned paintings by Raja Ravi Varma.
bangalore_palace.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (10:00 AM to 01:00 PM) to explore the royal courtyards and audioguided gallery.

tipu_sultan_summer_palace.name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
tipu_sultan_summer_palace.description: Historic two-storey teakwood palace completed in 1791 within the Bengaluru Fort complex. Known for ornate fluted wooden pillars, cusped arches, and a historical museum displaying Tipu Sultan's artifacts.
tipu_sultan_summer_palace.best_time_to_visit: Morning (09:00 AM to 12:00 PM) for tranquil heritage exploration.

vidhana_soudha.name: Vidhana Soudha
vidhana_soudha.description: Seat of Karnataka State Legislature, constructed in 1956 in monumental Neo-Dravidian architecture. Built entirely of Bangalore granite, crowned by four majestic lion capitals of Ashoka.
vidhana_soudha.best_time_to_visit: Sunday evenings and public holidays when the entire granite edifice is illuminated with thousands of lights.

attara_kacheri.name: Attara Kacheri (High Court of Karnataka)
attara_kacheri.description: Striking two-storey Pompeian red brick structure built in 1868 facing Vidhana Soudha. Originally housed 18 government departments and now serves as the seat of the Karnataka High Court.
attara_kacheri.best_time_to_visit: Daytime from Cubbon Park promenade to capture photographs of the heritage colonial facade.

visvesvaraya_museum.name: Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum
visvesvaraya_museum.description: Premier interactive science museum named after Bharat Ratna Sir M. Visvesvaraya. Features hands-on exhibits on engines, mechanics, biotechnology, electronics, and a full-scale Wright Brothers simulator.
visvesvaraya_museum.best_time_to_visit: 10:00 AM to 02:00 PM, highly recommended for students, children, and science enthusiasts.

jawaharlal_nehru_planetarium.name: Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium
jawaharlal_nehru_planetarium.description: Pioneering astronomical educational facility featuring a 15-meter dome Sky Theatre with hybrid digital projection, interactive Science Park, and scale models of solar system bodies.
jawaharlal_nehru_planetarium.best_time_to_visit: Catch the afternoon or evening Sky Theatre shows (check advance show timings online).

iskcon_temple_bangalore.name: Sri Radha Krishna ISKCON Temple
iskcon_temple_bangalore.description: Colossal neo-classical temple complex perched atop Hare Krishna Hill in Rajajinagar. Adorned with gold-plated flagstaff, glass-encased domes, Vedic museum, and renowned prasadam distribution.
iskcon_temple_bangalore.best_time_to_visit: Evening Aarti (07:00 PM to 08:30 PM) for devotional chanting and magnificent lighting.

bull_temple.name: Bull Temple (Dodda Basavana Gudi)
bull_temple.description: 16th-century temple built by Bengaluru's founder Kempe Gowda I, housing one of the world's largest monolithic Nandi bull statues carved out of a single granite rock, continually blackened with oil.
bull_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours or during the famous Kadalekai Parishe (Groundnut Fair) in November/December.

dodda_ganapathi_temple.name: Dodda Ganapathi Temple
dodda_ganapathi_temple.description: Ancient temple adjacent to Bull Temple featuring an enormous monolithic idol of Lord Ganesha standing 18 feet tall and 16 feet wide, famously coated with over 100 kg of butter (Benne Alankara).
dodda_ganapathi_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (07:00 AM to 11:00 AM) to witness traditional archana and butter decorations.

hal_aerospace_museum.name: HAL Heritage Centre and Aerospace Museum
hal_aerospace_museum.description: India's first aerospace museum showcasing the glorious history of Indian aviation. Displays actual fighter jets, commercial aircraft, helicopters, aero engines, and air traffic control flight simulators.
hal_aerospace_museum.best_time_to_visit: 10:00 AM to 03:00 PM for outdoor aircraft displays and simulator rides.

national_gallery_modern_art.name: National Gallery of Modern Art (NGMA)
national_gallery_modern_art.description: Prestigious art gallery set within the heritage Manikyavelu Mansion surrounded by century-old trees. Displays exquisite modern and contemporary art from Raja Ravi Varma, Amrita Sher-Gil, and Rabindranath Tagore.
national_gallery_modern_art.best_time_to_visit: 11:00 AM to 04:00 PM for leisurely gallery walks and relaxed garden cafe dining.

government_museum_bengaluru.name: Government Museum & Venkatappa Art Gallery
government_museum_bengaluru.description: One of India's oldest museums established in 1865, housing priceless archaeological artifacts, Hoysala and Vijayanagara stone sculptures, Roman coins, and the historic 5th-century Halmidi Kannada inscription.

karnataka_chitrakala_parishath.name: Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath
karnataka_chitrakala_parishath.description: Distinguished cultural art institution housing 13 permanent museum galleries featuring traditional Mysore paintings, leather puppets, and masterworks by Russian artist Nicholas Roerich.
karnataka_chitrakala_parishath.best_time_to_visit: Daytime during special seasonal art exhibitions or the annual Chitra Santhe festival.

ulsoor_lake.name: Ulsoor Lake (Halasuru Lake)
ulsoor_lake.description: Picturesque 120-acre urban lake developed by Kempe Gowda II, dotted with natural wooded islands. Features paved pedestrian jogging pathways, pedal boating facilities, and serene sunset viewpoints.
ulsoor_lake.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise (06:00 AM to 08:00 AM) for morning jogging or late afternoon for boating.

sankey_tank.name: Sankey Tank
sankey_tank.description: Serene man-made reservoir built in 1882 by Col. Richard Sankey to meet the city's water demands. Today it is a premier urban nature sanctuary with manicured gardens, paved walkways, and migratory waterbirds.
sankey_tank.best_time_to_visit: 06:00 AM to 09:00 AM or 05:00 PM to 07:00 PM for scenic lakeside breezes.

st_marys_basilica.name: St. Mary's Basilica
st_marys_basilica.description: Oldest church in Bengaluru elevated to the status of minor basilica in 1973. Renowned for its soaring Gothic revival arches, stained glass windows crafted in Paris, and the grand annual St. Mary's Feast in September.
st_marys_basilica.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours or during the annual feast festivities from August 29 to September 8.

gavi_gangadhareshwara_temple.name: Gavi Gangadhareshwara Cave Temple
gavi_gangadhareshwara_temple.description: Vedic rock-cut cave temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, famous for its astronomical marvel where direct sunlight passes through Nandi's horns onto the Shiva Lingam precisely during Makara Sankranti.
gavi_gangadhareshwara_temple.best_time_to_visit: Makara Sankranti festival (mid-January) or early morning for quiet cave meditation.

commercial_street.name: Commercial Street Shopping Hub
commercial_street.description: Iconic, bustling retail haven renowned across South India for trendy apparel, traditional footwear, imitation jewelry, bespoke tailoring, and vibrant street fashion at bargain prices.
commercial_street.best_time_to_visit: 03:00 PM to 08:30 PM for lively shopping experiences and local eateries.

brigade_road.name: Brigade Road & Church Street
brigade_road.description: Vibrant cosmopolitan lifestyle and retail strip lined with international brand flagships, independent secondhand bookshops like Blossom, live music pubs, and buzzing cafes.
brigade_road.best_time_to_visit: Evening hours (05:00 PM to 10:00 PM) for the energetic urban vibe and cafe culture.

mg_road_boulevard.name: MG Road Boulevard & Rangoli Art Centre
mg_road_boulevard.description: Elevated pedestrian promenade alongside Namma Metro viaduct on Mahatma Gandhi Road, integrated with the Rangoli Metro Art Center featuring art galleries, open-air performance spaces, and vertical gardens.
mg_road_boulevard.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon or evening for art exhibits, coffee, and urban photography.

ub_city.name: UB City Luxury Mall & Skydeck
ub_city.description: India's first bespoke luxury commercial and retail destination, featuring European classical architecture, elite global haute couture boutiques, fine-dining restaurants, and a panoramic rooftop skydeck.
ub_city.best_time_to_visit: Evening hours for luxury dining, ambient rooftop lounge views, and architectural grandeur.

kr_market.name: Krishna Rajendra (KR) Flower Market
kr_market.description: One of Asia's largest wholesale flower and fresh produce markets. An explosion of color and fragrance where mountains of marigolds, roses, jasmine garlands, and fragrant spices change hands.
kr_market.best_time_to_visit: 04:30 AM to 07:00 AM for the sensory spectacle of morning wholesale flower auctions.

gandhi_bazaar.name: Gandhi Bazaar
gandhi_bazaar.description: Cultural heart of Old Basavanagudi celebrated for traditional spice merchants, puja accoutrements, fresh flowers, and iconic heritage culinary institutions like Vidyarthi Bhavan serving crispy Benne Dosa.
gandhi_bazaar.best_time_to_visit: Morning (08:00 AM to 11:00 AM) for a heritage breakfast followed by traditional market walking.

malleshwaram_8th_cross.name: Malleshwaram 8th Cross Traditional Market
malleshwaram_8th_cross.description: Charming heritage market street steeped in old Bengaluru character, featuring traditional silk weavers, fresh jasmine vendors, brassware shops, and famous eateries like CTR (Shri Sagar).
malleshwaram_8th_cross.best_time_to_visit: Morning or late afternoon, followed by crispy butter benne masala dosa at CTR.

chickpet_bazaar.name: Chickpet Historic Silk Market
chickpet_bazaar.description: One of Bengaluru's oldest commercial areas founded over 400 years ago by Kempe Gowda. Famous nationwide for pure Kanjeevaram and Mysore silk sarees, bridal wear, and wholesale jewelry.
chickpet_bazaar.best_time_to_visit: 11:30 AM to 06:00 PM on weekdays to avoid extreme weekend pedestrian congestion.

shivoham_shiva_temple.name: Shivoham Shiva Temple
shivoham_shiva_temple.description: Prominent spiritual pilgrimage landmark on Old Airport Road featuring a towering 65-foot seated white monolith of Lord Shiva, a 32-foot Lord Ganesha idol, and an artificial replica of the 12 Jyotirlingas.
shivoham_shiva_temple.best_time_to_visit: Evening hours during aarti, or all night during the grand Maha Shivaratri celebrations.

bannerghatta_national_park.name: Bannerghatta Biological Park & Safari
bannerghatta_national_park.description: Sprawling wildlife reserve spanning over 25,000 acres, offering AC bus safaris to observe lions, tigers, and Asiatic bears roaming free, along with India's first dedicated Butterfly Park.
bannerghatta_national_park.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (09:30 AM to 12:30 PM) for active safari animal sightings (closed Tuesdays).

indian_music_experience_museum.name: Indian Music Experience Museum (IME)
indian_music_experience_museum.description: India's only interactive music museum, featuring high-tech audio-visual exhibits across classical ragas, folk traditions, Bollywood evolution, an interactive Sound Garden, and instruments gallery.
indian_music_experience_museum.best_time_to_visit: 11:00 AM to 04:00 PM for immersive audio tours and playing instruments in the Sound Garden.

nimhans_brain_museum.name: NIMHANS Brain Museum
nimhans_brain_museum.description: Unique neurobiology museum housed at the National Institute of Mental Health and Neurosciences, displaying over 600 preserved human brain specimens afflicted with various neurological conditions.
nimhans_brain_museum.best_time_to_visit: Check guided tour timings on Wednesdays (02:00 PM) or Saturdays (10:00 AM & 02:00 PM).

ragigudda_anjaneya_temple.name: Ragigudda Sri Prasanna Anjaneya Temple
ragigudda_anjaneya_temple.description: Venerated hilltop temple in Jayanagar dedicated to Lord Hanuman, believed to have originated from a massive mound of ragi (finger millet) that turned to stone. Features an artificial waterfall and tranquil gardens.
ragigudda_anjaneya_temple.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or during the grand 12-day Hanumath Jayanthi festival in December.

kote_venkataramana_temple.name: Kote Venkataramana Swamy Temple
kote_venkataramana_temple.description: Splendid 17th-century Dravidian temple built by ruler Chikka Devaraja Wadiyar inside the old Bengaluru Fort complex, featuring intricately carved pillars depicting avatars of Lord Vishnu.
kote_venkataramana_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (08:30 AM to 11:30 AM) to admire the delicate Vijayanagara stone carvings.

halasuru_someshwara_temple.name: Halasuru Someshwara Temple
halasuru_someshwara_temple.description: One of the oldest temples in Bengaluru tracing back to the Chola dynasty with Vijayanagara modifications. Features exquisite stone carvings of gods, animals, and mythological legends across its outer walls.
halasuru_someshwara_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning or early evening for peaceful heritage darshan.

banashankari_amma_temple.name: Banashankari Amma Temple
banashankari_amma_temple.description: Revered Shakta shrine founded in 1915, famous for the auspicious custom of offering lemon rind lamps (Nimbe Deepa) to Goddess Banashankari particularly during Rahu Kala periods.
banashankari_amma_temple.best_time_to_visit: Tuesdays, Fridays, or Sundays during Rahu Kala for special rituals and divine ambiance.

st_marks_cathedral.name: St. Mark's Cathedral
st_marks_cathedral.description: Colonial cathedral founded in 1808 on MG Road modeled after London's St Paul's Cathedral, boasting a classical domed roof, Roman arches, carved woodworks, and serene bell towers.
st_marks_cathedral.best_time_to_visit: Morning hours (09:00 AM to 12:00 PM) for quiet architectural contemplation.

infant_jesus_church.name: Infant Jesus Shrine & Church
infant_jesus_church.description: Famous Roman Catholic pilgrimage shrine established in 1971 in Viveka Nagar, celebrated for miraculous blessings and drawing thousands of devotees of all faiths to its Thursday Novena services.
infant_jesus_church.best_time_to_visit: Thursdays for the vibrant novena masses held in multiple Indian languages.

chokkanathaswamy_temple.name: Domlur Chokkanathaswamy Temple
chokkanathaswamy_temple.description: Historic 10th-century Chola temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu as Chokkanatha Perumal. Features authentic Tamil stone inscriptions recording generous royal grants by Rajendra Chola I and Hoysala kings.
chokkanathaswamy_temple.best_time_to_visit: Morning (07:00 AM to 10:00 AM) to read the ancient epigraphic carvings on the basement walls.

art_of_living_ashram.name: Art of Living International Center
art_of_living_ashram.description: Expansive 65-acre spiritual sanctuary founded by Sri Sri Ravi Shankar, featuring the five-tiered lotus-shaped Vishalakshi Mantap, amphitheaters, herbal gardens, and holistic wellness programs.
art_of_living_ashram.best_time_to_visit: Evening satsang hours (06:00 PM to 08:30 PM) for soul-stirring music and meditation.

indira_gandhi_musical_fountain.name: Indira Gandhi Musical Fountain Park
indira_gandhi_musical_fountain.description: Technologically sophisticated dancing musical fountain set inside an attractive landscaped park opposite Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium, featuring rhythmic water jets coordinated with Hindi and Kannada melodies.
indira_gandhi_musical_fountain.best_time_to_visit: Evening show times (07:00 PM and 08:00 PM, closed on Mondays).

bugle_rock_park.name: Bugle Rock Geological Park
bugle_rock_park.description: Precious geological marvel consisting of an abrupt rock formation of peninsular gneiss estimated to be 3,000 million years old, crowned with a historic watchtower built by Kempe Gowda I.
bugle_rock_park.best_time_to_visit: Early morning or late afternoon for scenic vantage views of Basavanagudi.

gandhi_bhavan.name: Gandhi Bhavan
gandhi_bhavan.description: Serene memorial museum situated in Kumara Park East established by President Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, showcasing rare photographs, historic letters, and publications narrating Mahatma Gandhi's life.
gandhi_bhavan.best_time_to_visit: 11:00 AM to 04:00 PM for quiet historical reflection and browsing Gandhian literature.

orion_mall.name: Orion Mall & Gateway Lake Promenade
orion_mall.description: Premium 1.1 million sq ft retail, leisure, and entertainment destination in Brigade Gateway, featuring a picturesque man-made lake promenade, top international brands, and diverse global dining.
orion_mall.best_time_to_visit: Late afternoon to catch sunset views across the lakeside promenade followed by dinner.

phoenix_marketcity_whitefield.name: Phoenix Marketcity Whitefield
phoenix_marketcity_whitefield.description: East Bengaluru's largest lifestyle and shopping complex, boasting premier global brands, vast open-air courtyards hosting concerts, diverse international restaurants, and gaming arenas.
phoenix_marketcity_whitefield.best_time_to_visit: Afternoon to evening for weekend shopping, fine dining, and live musical events.

snow_city_bangalore.name: Snow City Bangalore
snow_city_bangalore.description: Massive indoor sub-zero snow theme park kept at minus 5 degrees Celsius, offering real snowfall, ice slides, snow rafting, igloos, and snow rock-climbing within the Fun World complex.
snow_city_bangalore.best_time_to_visit: Midday session (11:00 AM to 03:00 PM) to escape tropical afternoon heat.

wonderla_amusement_park.name: Wonderla Amusement Park
wonderla_amusement_park.description: World-class 82-acre amusement and water theme park on Mysore Road with over 60 thrilling high-adrenalin dry and wet rides, wave pools, roller coasters, and solar-heated water facilities.
wonderla_amusement_park.best_time_to_visit: Arrive early at 11:00 AM on weekdays to maximize ride access with minimal queues.

lumbini_gardens.name: Lumbini Gardens
lumbini_gardens.description: Unique water-front eco-leisure park developed along the tranquil banks of Nagavara Lake, boasting pedal boats, an artificial beach wave pool, floating restaurants, and children's amusement rides.
lumbini_gardens.best_time_to_visit: 04:00 PM to 07:00 PM for lake boating and enjoying sunset across Nagavara Lake.

hmt_heritage_museum.name: HMT Heritage Centre & Watch Museum
hmt_heritage_museum.description: Nostalgic industrial museum in Jalahalli commemorating the 'Timekeeper to the Nation'. Displays vintage mechanical and quartz wristwatches, Braille dials, tractors, and precision industrial machines.

devanahalli_fort.name: Devanahalli Fort
devanahalli_fort.description: Historic stone-bastioned fortress sprawling across 20 acres built in 1501 by Mallabaire Gowda, famous as the birthplace of Tipu Sultan. Contains living heritage settlements and ancient temples.
devanahalli_fort.best_time_to_visit: Morning (08:00 AM to 11:00 AM) or late afternoon to explore the stone ramparts.

jayanagar_4th_block_shopping.name: Jayanagar 4th Block Shopping Complex
jayanagar_4th_block_shopping.description: Beloved commercial nerve center of South Bengaluru featuring the landmark multi-storey BDA shopping complex, buzzing street kiosks, traditional jewelry showrooms, and legendary South Indian street eateries.
jayanagar_4th_block_shopping.best_time_to_visit: 04:30 PM to 09:00 PM for street shopping, fresh sugarcane juice, and hot masala dosas.
